scope: Blocks reintroduction of legacy creator onboarding, Admin Roster, agreement, creator experience, profile routing, synthetic creator, and view-as patterns after canonical creator lane hardening.

canonicalFlow.projectionRule: users/{uid}.creatorApplication is projection only and must not become a lifecycle source of truth.

remainingLegacyExceptions.allowedReason: Deprecated compatibility bridge for legacy admin user updates; any creatorApplication patch is sanitized, converted into canonical creator_onboarding state, written through syncCreatorOnboardingDocuments, materialized into creator_review_queue, audited, and actor-marked.
remainingLegacyExceptions.removalPlan: Remove creatorApplication patch support after Admin User profile editing no longer needs legacy projection compatibility and all lifecycle actions use /api/admin/creators/[userId]/action.
remainingLegacyExceptions.risk: Medium: if future callers use this route for lifecycle decisions, they can bypass the decision-queue action shape even though the route currently rebuilds canonical state.

remainingLegacyExceptions.allowedReason: Projection builder and normalizer for users/{uid}.creatorApplication so creator waitlist and old user-profile consumers can keep reading a derived view.
remainingLegacyExceptions.removalPlan: Keep until all creator-facing status surfaces read a canonical display projection and the nested user projection can be deleted.
remainingLegacyExceptions.risk: Low: safe while comments and validators keep it projection-only.

remainingLegacyExceptions.allowedReason: Bounded migration adapter for reading old users/{uid}.creatorApplication records and mapping them into canonical onboarding without overwriting stronger canonical evidence.
remainingLegacyExceptions.removalPlan: Delete after the dry-run inventory reports no migration-needed legacy records across production/staging and migration write mode is no longer needed.
remainingLegacyExceptions.risk: Low: adapter refuses to infer legal/signature completion without evidence.

remainingLegacyExceptions.allowedReason: Dry-run inventory script for finding old users/{uid}.creatorApplication records before any canonical backfill.
remainingLegacyExceptions.removalPlan: Remove after migration inventory stays empty for a launch stabilization window.
remainingLegacyExceptions.risk: Low: dry-run default and write mode is intentionally unavailable.

remainingLegacyExceptions.allowedReason: Central canonical sync helper writes creator_onboarding first, then rebuilds users.creatorApplication and creator_review_queue projections in one server-controlled path.
remainingLegacyExceptions.removalPlan: Keep as long as projection consumers exist; later remove only the users.creatorApplication projection write after all consumers are migrated.
remainingLegacyExceptions.risk: Medium: highest leverage path, but currently the safest single bridge because it keeps canonical, projection, queue, and history aligned.

remainingLegacyExceptions.allowedReason: Admin Roster API may read the user projection as fallback/debug context while canonical onboarding and review queue remain the decision source.
remainingLegacyExceptions.removalPlan: Remove fallback reads after creator_review_queue and canonical onboarding cover all historical creator applicants.
remainingLegacyExceptions.risk: Medium: fallback must never become role-only intake filtering or lifecycle write authority.

remainingLegacyExceptions.allowedReason: Admin user detail may reconstruct a canonical-looking detail from the old projection only when creator_onboarding is absent, so Debug can expose old records for cleanup.
remainingLegacyExceptions.removalPlan: Remove after the legacy migration inventory has no projection-only creator records.
remainingLegacyExceptions.risk: Medium: fallback must be labeled legacy/debug and must not write lifecycle state.

remainingLegacyExceptions.allowedReason: Roster client may read normalized projection fields already returned by server APIs for selected-record context; lifecycle actions use typed creator actions.
remainingLegacyExceptions.removalPlan: Remove projection fallback fields after server payloads stop exposing user.creatorApplication for selected details.
remainingLegacyExceptions.risk: Low: UI warnings and actions are canonical/queue-driven, not direct blob writes.

remainingLegacyExceptions.allowedReason: Creator waitlist status still reads the derived user projection because it is the creator-facing display contract for onboarding status.
remainingLegacyExceptions.removalPlan: Replace with a canonical status endpoint after legacy projection migration is complete.
remainingLegacyExceptions.risk: Low: display-only when the server keeps projection synchronized from canonical onboarding.

remainingLegacyExceptions.allowedReason: Public creator helper may use approval projection as fallback until a dedicated public creator profile source fully replaces it.
remainingLegacyExceptions.removalPlan: Move public creator visibility to role/public-profile state only after canonical profile routing and profile publication records are complete.
remainingLegacyExceptions.risk: Medium: public routes must not expose private onboarding/legal/ID fields.

notes: The scanner fails on old logic patterns unless the file/pattern is a named exception in this report.
Adding a new exception requires owner, allowedReason, removalPlan, and risk.
Existing creator-lane targeted validations remain required signoff gates.
